newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-MARADONA SAYS HOSPITALIZED FOR HEALTH, NOT DRUGS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARADONA SAYS HOSPITALIZED FOR HEALTH, NOT DRUGS.

text.p: Diego Maradona said Friday night he checked into hospital late Thursday for health reasons and not for drugs.
Maradona arrived at an exclusive Buenos Aires clinic Thursday night just days after he was rushed to hospital in Chile after feeling ill on a television chat show.
"It was my own decision. When you suddenly fall ill like that you get a bit scared," Maradona told reporters in hospital.

"I came to hospital and not because of drugs. I say this because some people claim if you take drugs you can never leave them -- that's totally false," he said, referring to rumours he went to hospital for drug rehabilitation.
Hospital officials said Maradona would remain there for a week to undergo a thorough checkup, and that so far the tests carried out were normal.

Argentina's 1986 World Cup winning captain broke out in a cold sweat on a Chilean chat show on Monday night after dancing a tango with former Miss Universe Cecilia Bolocco. He was taken to hospital and diagnosed with high blood pressure.
Maradona returned to Buenos Aires the next day, where local media reported he spent the night dancing at a nightclub.
